summary: AGILA Hub Android — Phase 00 Master Architecture & Implementation Plan, Revision 3.8 (Production Architecture & Testable Baseline Specification). Fully resolves all remaining blockers: aligns preflight assertions with actual schema definitions (idx_members_email_lower on LOWER(email), uq_reference_payment on (payment_channel, reference_number), and idx_sections_embedding with HNSW cosine similarity), strengthens restore script with independent trusted production endpoint verification and canonical IP checks, expands post-restore assertions to verify referential integrity across all member references in expenses (recorded_by, approved_by, reversed_by) and active RLS across ALL public tables, and provides concrete test fixtures while keeping all runtime tests explicitly marked NOT EXECUTED.
